replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Small tip: Do .zip instead of .rar. You need software for .rar but not for .zip as windows comes with it.

Overall the map layout is nice but the palette is not that great. Mix in cobblestone in the stone brick and do something new with it as this palette is used on a lot of maps (or similar at least).

Not sure if there are iron blocks underground but seeing as it is right now the amount seems very small and should be changed so there is more iron. The diamonds are a nice addition to the map but you should lower the amount.

Map seems quite flat so I recommend working on some height changes. 1 block changes in height can make a huge difference. Also put some barriers to the frontlines as cover.

I also think you should make it slightly bigger so there is more area to PVP at.

Decent layout and a nice idea but needs work.

replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
#SkyBreezily 

Yeah. That's all Ima do. 

IMO it doesn't give enough paths to rush from, making PvP skills a must for rushers, which I feel shouldn't, be nessicary. 
It kinda mixes Luar and Bleened Rings together. I'd also like if you made the map a bit larger. I don't like the fact that you have to fight for iron and that the people who get there first will just camp there and kill everyone. Only option for rushing would be Skybridging. I feel like with some tweaks this map could be great. I feel like the middle islands cramp the map up a bit, try making the map wider as well.
